scenes.headline: How a model learns what its harness did for it
scenes.sub: Recursive Self-Rewrite: re-solve every success under one plain loop.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Kulfi! A smarter loop helps a model solve more terminal tasks. Here's how to move that skill into the weights.

scenes.text: Don't train on a success from a heavy harness. Turn it into a runbook, then solve the task again under the plain harness.
scenes.mark: solve the task again under the plain harness
scenes.say: The idea: don't train on a success from a heavy harness. Turn it into a runbook, and solve the task again under the plain loop.

steps.say: One base model runs under three different loops. Each one solves tasks the others miss.
As planner, the same model reads a passing run, harness messages cut, and writes a runbook: milestones, checks, pitfalls.

steps.note: the recursive part: reject, give the reason, redraft
steps.say: As critic, it rejects a runbook that leaks the answer, and sends it back with the reason. That loop is the recursion.
As executor, it solves the task again in a fresh sandbox, under the plain loop. The runbook guides it but never enters the log.
Only runs that pass the verifier, with no values the model could not have derived, become training data.

scenes.title: Two ways to use the successes

left.title: Direct fine-tuning
items: Train on the raw successful runs
Learns to expect a missing controller
left.say: Train on the raw successes, and the model learns habits that needed the old controller. Its score went down.

right.title: Recursive Self-Rewrite
right.say: Rewrite them instead, and every kept run is a real success under the loop the model will use.

steps.say: Here is the OpenFOAM task. The source run issues harness commands. The passing rewrite reaches the same result without any of them.

scenes.title: Terminal-Bench 2, pass@3
scenes.note: one round of supervised fine-tuning, about six times more data
scenes.say: On Terminal-Bench 2, pass at three goes from fifty-seven to seventy-four point two. Direct fine-tuning had dropped it. One caveat: the rewrite set is far larger.

scenes.text: A success under a heavy harness is a hint, not a demonstration: solve it again under the loop you will deploy.

scenes.say: To recap: discover with many loops, rewrite through a runbook and a critic, and train only on verified re-solves.
